t: Four requests said as he lay down
a: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَأَخْسِئْ شَيْطَانِي وَفُكَّ رِهَانِي وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي النَّدِيِّ الأَعْلَى
p: Bismi-Llāhi waḍaʿtu janbī. Allāhumma-ghfir lī dhanbī, wa akhsiʾ shayṭānī, wa fukka rihānī, wa-jʿalnī fi-n-nadiyyi-l-aʿlā
m: In the name of Allah I have laid down my side. O Allah, forgive my sin, drive off my devil, release what I have pledged, and place me in the highest company.
